source_title: Christa Pike speaks of constant pain after botched execution
source_excerpt:
Christa Pike has released her first statement since her botched execution in late September. ( Reuters )
Christa Pike has made her first statement since surviving a botched execution in September.
The 50-year-old says she is in "constant pain" and blames her failed execution on "incompetence".
She had been sentenced to death over the 1995 stabbing death of 19-year-old classmate Colleen Slemmer.
Christa Pike says she remains in constant pain and struggles to speak a month after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee, a failure she blames on "incompetence".
In her first public statement since the execution, Pike said she never contemplated a life beyond her execution date and was prepared to die in peace, but woke up alone and confused in a hospital bed.
"There hasn't been a moment since that night when I haven't been in pain," she said.
Pike, 50, survived two doses of pentobarbital as the state tried to execute her on September 30 for the 1995 stabbing death of 19-year-old classmate Colleen Slemmer.
Pike was 18 when she and her boyfriend tortured and killed Ms Slemmer, becoming one of the youngest women to be sentenced to death.
"I'm deeply hurt by the incompetence that has put so many people in this terrible position," she said. "I continue to think about my victim's family and the terrible pain and loss they have endured."
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has called for an investigation into what happened during the failed execution and postponed the state's other lethal injection scheduled this year. The state's prison chief resigned.
Pike said she was thankful for the medical workers who saved her life and the people who showed her kindness.
"Some days, finding hope is harder than others. For now, I am trying to heal, one day at a time. And I am holding on to the love and kindness of so many people who have reminded me that I am not alone."
The failed lethal injection left her arms burned and blistered, according to her lawyers.
For the first few days of her hospitalisation, Pike was unconscious and on a ventilator. Medical and lethal injection experts have focused on the possibility that a problem with the IV line caused the drug to pool in her tissue rather than entering her bloodstream.
Pike's attorneys have urged the governor to reduce her sentence to life imprisonment. Lee told reporters this week that, "I suspect her sentence will be the same as before unless determined otherwise by the courts."
Friday's statement was dictated to Pike's legal team from the infirmary at the prison where she is housed. Pike was hospitalised in the immediate aftermath of the failed execution and then moved back to prison at the Debra K. Johnson Rehabilitation Center.
hi_body:
टेनेसी की डेथ रो कैदी 50 वर्षीय क्रिस्टा पाइक ने 30 सितंबर को हुए विफल निष्पादन (एग्जीक्यूशन) के बाद अपना पहला सार्वजनिक बयान जारी किया है। पाइक का कहना है कि उन्हें 'लगातार दर्द' हो रहा है और उन्हें बोलने में कठिनाई का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। उन्होंने इस विफलता के लिए 'अक्षमता' को जिम्मेदार ठहराया है।

## घटना का विवरण
* पाइक को 1995 में कोलीन स्लेमर की हत्या के मामले में मौत की सजा दी गई थी।
* निष्पादन के दौरान उन्हें पेंटोबार्बिटल की दो खुराक दी गई थीं, लेकिन वह जीवित बच गईं।
* उनके वकीलों के अनुसार, इस प्रक्रिया के कारण उनकी बाहों में जलन और छाले हो गए थे।
* अस्पताल में इलाज और वेंटिलेटर पर रहने के बाद, उन्हें वापस डेबरा के. जॉनसन रिहैबिलिटेशन सेंटर भेज दिया गया है।

## आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया
टेनेसी के गवर्नर बिल ली ने निष्पादन प्रक्रिया की जांच के आदेश दिए हैं और राज्य में अन्य नियोजित घातक इंजेक्शनों पर रोक लगा दी है। इस घटना के बाद राज्य के जेल प्रमुख ने इस्तीफा दे दिया है। पाइक की कानूनी टीम ने गवर्नर से उनकी सजा को आजीवन कारावास में बदलने का आग्रह किया है, हालांकि गवर्नर ली ने कहा है कि जब तक अदालत कोई अन्य फैसला नहीं लेती, उनकी सजा पहले जैसी ही रहने की उम्मीद है।

## पाइक की वर्तमान स्थिति
जेल के इंफर्मरी से अपनी कानूनी टीम के माध्यम से भेजे गए बयान में, पाइक ने उन चिकित्सा कर्मियों के प्रति आभार व्यक्त किया जिन्होंने उनकी जान बचाई। वह वर्तमान में चिकित्सा निगरानी में हैं और अपनी रिकवरी का प्रयास कर रही हैं।
hi_title: टेनेसी में निष्पादन विफल होने के बाद क्रिस्टा पाइक का पहला बयान
hi_meta: टेनेसी में विफल निष्पादन के बाद क्रिस्टा पाइक ने अपना पहला बयान जारी किया है, जिसमें उन्होंने लगातार दर्द और व्यवस्था की अक्षमता का जिक्र किया है।
en_body:
Christa Pike, a 50-year-old death row inmate in Tennessee, has issued her first public statement since surviving a botched lethal injection attempt on September 30. Pike reports suffering from "constant pain" and struggles to speak, blaming the failed procedure on "incompetence."

## Details of the Incident
* Pike was scheduled for execution for the 1995 murder of Colleen Slemmer.
* She survived two doses of pentobarbital during the attempt.
* Her lawyers report that she sustained burns and blisters on her arms.
* Following the attempt, Pike was hospitalized, placed on a ventilator, and later transferred back to the Debra K. Johnson Rehabilitation Center.

## Official Response
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has ordered an investigation into the execution process and suspended other planned lethal injections in the state. Following the incident, the state's prison chief resigned from their position. While Pike’s legal team has requested the governor commute her sentence to life imprisonment, Governor Lee stated he expects the original sentence to remain unless court rulings dictate otherwise.

## Pike's Current Status
In her statement, dictated to her legal team from the prison infirmary, Pike expressed gratitude toward the medical staff who treated her. She remains under medical observation as she attempts to recover, while continuing to reflect on the impact of her crime on the victim's family.
